scientific_integrity: A complete self-contained finite-field proof and reproducibility script are provided; no independent external audit or experimental proof of the infinite assertion is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats a specific quadratic-tangent Kakeya configuration in F_(3^m)^2 with odd m>=3, uniform probability mass, and the standard additive-character Fourier transform; no general classification of Kakeya measures is claimed. The analytical proof uses classical quadratic Gauss sums, and the supplementary checker is numerical and finite.
title: Four-level uniform Fourier spectrum of quadratic-tangent Kakeya sets over odd-degree ternary fields
